Lyngdoh, (1997) F1RSr EDITION 1997 1997 La shon ha Scorpio Printers Mawkhar, Shillong state Cfral Librw. Shillonr --- Page 5 --- Ka Jingthmu Ka jingthmu ba kongsan jong kane ka long (f) ban pynshai ia ki samla pule (2),ban ai jingmut ja ki Dongthoh kot 'Khasi ki jong ka pyrther salonsar bad (3) ban pun jingkieog ia kiwei pat' ki riewstad. khnang ba kin sngewthuh ia ki jingthew ba.

thikna, bad ba donkam ia kiba don ha ka jylli jong, ka aim thoh poitri. Shikyntien, kane ka ,pynlong ia u nongthob ban ngeit ba kane,kam da pynhun eh ia u nongthoh; namar ka dang lyngkot eh. Hynrei'kumno la kumno, u kyrmen pat ba kane ka jingpyrshang barit kan plie lad plio lynti ia ki pateng kiba dangmih bad dungkhie, sha ka jingtip bed jingsngewthuh kham janai ia jor tynrai jong ka ain thaw bad thoh poitri.

Haba nga shim kyllum jong kane ,ka jingtrei, nga la phiah sekshon -pa-sekshon, bad haman ki sekshon, gd l pyns ai ia ki kyntien; da kaba nga la, shim nuksa de ba,ki, nongthoh, poitri ia ki'katto katne ki jingkyili; khnang ba kin iarap ia ki nong- pule ia kiba kin sngewthuh ia ki ain bad jingthew ba don ha da lade hi. Nga phah ia kane ka jingtrei sha ka pyrthei da ka jingkyr. kaba ia ksaid sha ka jing pynbiang bad jingshakri ia ka thoh ka tar ha ki sngi kiba hadicn.
Dated Lawsohtun RAIJESH K. LYNGDOH, M A., M. Phil The 15th January, 1977.
--- Page 6 --- Shaphang ka Prosodi Content Section Page 1. Ka Prosodi 1-4 I. Ka jingtuid - jinghiar jong ki kyonoh ktien ne kyntien.

5-7 Ki kyrteng kiba, pher ba pher jong ka metre (Metre). Ka jingithuh ia ki kynnoh ktien Kt' bakhia bad ki basting Ki kyrteng kaba la tip ha ka ain thoh poitri. 10-15 Ka rukom pynjah ktien bad thoh ktien tam 16-19 VII.

Ka rukom (Scansion) ym tang ha ka khasi poitri hyarei ruh ha ka English poitri. 20 - 22 KI JINGPYRSHANG 23-26 --- Page 7 --- Ka Prosodi SEKSHON-I Ka Prosodi ka dei ka ain thoh poitri. Ka long ruh shibynta jong ka Grammar.

Ka long kaba iasnoh bad ka jingthew, haba ja kiba don ha ki lain De dkhot jingrwai. Shikyatien, lah ban ong ba ka prosodi ka iajan eh bad ka jingthew (metro). Dei da kumta baj Ka metre ka mut ka jingthew.

Kane jingthew ka long kaba ju pyndonkam ha ki poitri ia ki ktien ba sting bad ba khia. 1 Lah ruh ban sngewthuh ba,! ka thob poitri da kaba buh ia ki ktien ba jlan ne ba khia (stress);bad don ruh ki kyntien ba sting (unstress) ha ki kynnoh ktien, ki long ki bynta kiba kynthup ia ka ktien tang kawei ka sur jopg u vowel tang kawei ka kyntien ba khia (stress) ne artylli ki sur kynnoh ktien ba ki lain ki bymkbia (unstress).

Kane, ka jingkylla hapdeng ka jingkhiu bad jingsting, kaba u poit u lah ban pyndonkam ia kynnoh ktien la ka dei ka jingkhia ne jiugshoh ba sting 2 1, Lypgdoh, Raijesh K. : Unpublised M. Disertation cntitied Ka buit thaw poitri U Soso Tham.

cit P. --- Page 8 --- Ngi dei han kynmaw ba ka thoh prose kam da donkameh ja ki kynnoh kten bi khia la ki don ne jia h3 ki jingthoh; katba ha ka thoh poitrizpetborebor la:pynip pynbiang da ki kynnohktienbakhia iakiba"kin"donnejiabadshohdha iman la' ka par haba pule ne kren. Bunsiea busien.

nga shem ba ka kynnoh ktien ba khia ka don tang uwei u vowel, haba la kynnoh ilan bid Ting sur de'ha kajuh ka por. khnang ba yn tah ban pyniapher ia. kiwei ki ktien ne kyntien na kiwei pat, kiba don ha kajuh ka lain ne sentens.

Pynban halor kane nga shem ba ju don palat.ban ja  wai u vowel ne ki dak kiba sawa Ja kum u vowel hi(semi vovel) ha kajub ka sur kynnoh kten. Lada shim nuksa kum ka ktien "Myiusiem Hargne, ngi ichi ba dop artylt -ki.yowel ie bad .ia uwel usemivowel:Y.lat- ba ka khia sur pat ka.wan shob ha u vowel e, kum : mynsie'm Nangta shuh shuh kum ka ktien "Nyngkoig'. Hangne n!l ion!

ba don uwei u vowel : o baa u wei"u semivowel : Y; hyn. rei la ka kynnoh khiasur pat ka hap hauwei uvowel : Okum: nyngko'ng bad kiwei de. Lada phaikhyndiat shaka kynnoh khia sur jong ka English Literature kum ka nnksa ja ka kti-n "dier.
Hangne, 'ngi lobi ba dcn arvlli ki vowel ie; kumta ba ka kynnoh khia sur ka wan jia ha u vowel i ym ha u v). wel e, kum : di'et. Lada shim nuksa shuh shuh kum ka kticn 'dais".

Hangne ngi shem ruh ba don artylli ki vowel : ai : katba ka kynnoh khia sur pat ka wan shoh ba u vuwel a ym ha u vovel i, kum : da'is Nangta shh shub kum ka nuksa ia ka kticn "diary" Hangne, ngi shem ba don artylli ki vowel : ka wan shoh ha u vowel i ym ha u vowel a, kum: di'ary. Nangta shuh shuh kum ka nuksa ia ka ktien beauty' Hangne pgi ba don lai tyllt ki vowel : cau, bad uwei pat ti' semi, vowel': Y; hynrei ngt shem ba ka kynnoh khiasur pat ka wan jiar bid shoh ha u vowel u kum. beau'ty, bud ningta kiwei kiwel de.

Lah ban ithuh ia ki kynnoh ktien bakhia lada ngi peit na ki dak ki'shin kum ia ka kynnoh khii sur la ithuh da u dak (sign) kum : () katba ja ka kynnoh stingsur pat la ithuh da u dak(sign) kum:(-) Ngi dei 'ban kynmaw bs ka, kynnoh ktien khiasurkadonym tang ha uvowel; hynrei ruhha ki semivowei ha ki lain ne sentens. Pynhan halor kane, Dgi lah ruh ban peit thuh ia ki kynnoh ktien kiba khia. ia kiba don ha ki khup jong ki lain ne seatens.

Dei na kane ka liang ba ngi fab ban 'pyniapher ia, ki, kynnoh ,ktien ne kyntien,, kiba don ba ki lainne sentens; da kaba pyni ia u lain uba thiah, bad uba la ihuh da u dak (sign): (/). Une u long u dak uha pvn- iakhlad ne pynbynta ia ki kbup ha ki lain ne sentens. Ngi lab ban spgewthuh khambha, lada ngi bishar na ka nuksa jong kane --- Page 9 --- Nangbeb ko, lyer pyngnged.

nangbeh. Shane sha thain u Lum Mynjneh;1 Halor kitei ar tylli ki lain poitri, haneng, ngi iohi ba' don bun tylll ki vowel.Kan kham bha'ia nga bao shim bad pyn: shal ia kawe! pa kawei ka ktien jong ka lain ne sentens.La- don ar tylli ki vowei : a e bad kiba sah patki lopgki daks jong u consonant; hyniei i ka kynnoh khia sur pat ka wag jid bad shoh ba u vowel e kum: Nangbe'h.

Ladashim lang i ka ktien "Ko Lyer". Hangne,, ngi iohi ba doa u yowel; O, ningta u semi vowel : Y, bad u vowel : e. L.da bishar pat nd ki dak kiha sah ki dei ki dak jong u consonant, Te lada shim pat ia ka kyntoh khia sur ka wan shoh ha.
vowe! kuin : ko lye'r. Lada sbim la ka ktien  Pyngngad" patka jia Iyrgkat ba kd don lavg uwei u vowel: a.

bad uwei pat u se- mi vowel: Y. bad kiba sah pat ki dei ki dak jong u consonant; kuinta ia ka kynnoh khia sur pat ka wan shoh, ha u vowel, ? kum : Pyaguga'dLada shim ia ktiea "Nangbeh" bad kane,ka puw kumba la hata haneng.

Lada nga phai mynta sha ka iaid De senten ba sab jong ka jingpynshai, bud la kane ruh kan bha ha ka lain ne sentens., Lada 'shin ia ka ktieo "Shane". Hangne, ngt iohi ba don' ar tylli ki vowe! bad ki dak kiba sai ki dei jong u consouant'.
pynban ka kynnob ktien khia, sur. pi ka wun shoh ha u vowei c, kum: shane'. Ladd shim lang ia'ka vuwel; a, bad kiba sah ki dei ki dak jong u consonant.

Kumta ai, bud kiba sdh pat ki dei ki dak jong u consoaant ; katba ka kynnoh ktien khiasur pdt ka wau shoh ha u vowel 'i, kum; sha thai'n. Lada shim ia ka ktian 'U Lum" Hangne, Dgi lobl bd don tang u wei u yowei: u, bad kiba sah pat ki' dei ki dak jong consonant,tangba ka ktien "u"ia kaba don,ha hadten bad la tip kum u article: U, borabor ki don ki_iigsawa sidjem basting., Dei, na kata daw ka ne baka kum: kynnohkhia surka wan shohha u vowel Lu'm Lada shim ia ka kyrtengMynjneh Hangne ngi iohi ba don taug uwel u vowel : e, bad uwel u semi vowel: Y; kumta la pat' kideiki ki dak ktba sah dak jong. u consonant: Lada ka long kumtei la iobiba ka kynnoh ktiea khia.
sur.ka Mynjne'h. buh wan shoh hg vowel e. kum: beit ryatib ia kitei ki lain jingrwai baneng bad da kumne harum : Nangbe'h/ko lye'r/pyngnga'd,/nangbe'h; Shane'/sha thai'n/u Lu'm/Mynjne'h ; 1.
Lypgdoh, Raijesh K.. Kt kynud Rwai Khast (1981) P. --- Page 10 --- Nga, shem ba don ki mylung , kiba sngewtynnad ban pyn.

donkam ia ka rukom thaw poitri;da kaba pynjia ia kynuoh khia sur ha u semi vowel. Ngan kyrshan ia katei ka nia Da ka rukom thaw poitri u Byron da kum kane harum : The Assy'r/ian came do'wn/like a wo'if/on the fo'ld. Ha katei ka lain haneng.

ngi johi ba ka . don1 ka jingtbew kong, ia kaba ka kynnoh khia sur ka shob ha u wan semi vowel : Y. Lah ruh ban kyrshan ia katei ka nia da kane ka lain harum : Ka sha'd/kynthei' /sbynra'ng/ka py'n/mylle'n, 2.

Katei ka lain ka long Iambik sankhup; tangba ha ka khup vowel: Y Nga lah ruh ban shem ba don ki poit kiba ju pydonkam na ki rukom thaw poitri, haba ka kynnoh ktien 'khia' sur ka wan hap ha u consonant hi ruh.Nan kyrshan ia katei ka nia; da kaba sei nuksa na ka ukom thaw poitri u F. Pugh's phawar pharshi. da kane harum : Da jin'g/bha ngan ai'/ban ym sha'r/ki sla'.
Ha katei ka lain haneng, ngi iohi ba u F. Pugh um shym 'uiel, !y yose. ey, isadeuy ey e!

ee inp uemuad ueg qel e! pynban u pyniasnoh ia ka buit, thaw poitri: da, kaba u pynia- kbieh lang bad ki kaito katrne ki kynnoh ktien khia sur ba ka dur Iambik. bad u da pynjia ryngkhat ruh ba kaba kbiasur ka wan shoh ha ka khup nyngkong u consonant .
Lyngdob, Op. cit, P.
